sentence: This project works to improve an imaging method that measures positronium lifetime in the human body.
This project builds tools to see how proteins and nucleic acids move, are organized and interact at the molecular level.
This project studies how a pathway silences repetitive elements in cancer cells while DNA is copied, and whether blocking it could stop tumor growth.
This project studies how calcium signaling in the unicellular pathogen Toxoplasma gondii helps cause disease.
This project studies how the striatum processes auditory information and turns it into actions.
This project builds an in vivo model of a genetic cancer syndrome and tests a diet that restricts purine to control the disease.
This project runs clinical trials of new agents and treatment strategies for children and adolescents with cancer.
This project studies how nucleoporin family members help cause disease as people age, using mouse models and patient cells.
This project uses machine learning on magnetic resonance imaging to find patterns behind white matter hyperintensities, a common age-related finding in the brain.
This project studies how invasive water hyacinth changes the spread of schistosomiasis, to adapt an environmental control strategy.
This project studies how oxidative stress in heart cells leads to harm from the chemotherapy doxorubicin.
This project studies the molecular steps of Transforming Growth Factor Beta family signaling and how that signaling is regulated.
This project develops an immunotherapy using an adeno-associated virus to restore tolerance in multiple sclerosis by expanding regulatory T-cells.
This project studies the shapes and movements of transporters that cause multidrug resistance in bacteria and humans.
This project studies how treatment choices and social factors like healthcare coverage and neighborhood relate to glucose control and complications in type 2 diabetes.
This project designs and tests proteolysis targeting chimeras to improve paclitaxel treatment of ovarian cancer.
This project studies how loss of cofilin-1 harms mitochondrial quality control in airway epithelial cells in chronic bronchitis.
This project builds machine-learning tools that analyze the structure and morphology of subcellular objects across cell populations using Cryo-Electron Tomography.
This project builds causal machine learning models that recommend treatments for critically ill adults, and a decision support tool.
This project studies how immune cells shape antibody responses to coronavirus vaccines in mice and tests vaccine candidates in nonhuman primates.
